claims.claim: shows real recurring pain AND a crowded field
claims.evidence: r/personaltraining thread 'What software are you using to manage clients?' — trainers named 9+ tools (Trainerize, TrueCoach, SuperSet, Everfit, ...).
In-thread ask: 'do you have any template you can share?' — direct want for a template.
Coaching SaaS runs $20-150/mo, expensive for a 10-client coach; summary of coach software pain points.

claims.claim: Trainerize scaling pricing creates frustration for growing independent coaches.
claims.evidence: User reports paying $77/mo for up to 30 clients and feeling nickel-and-dimed by $4.99-$14.99/mo add-ons.

claims.claim: One-time spreadsheet templates serve as a direct alternative to per-seat coaching software.
claims.evidence: Market sources show Excel/Sheets templates priced at $1.99-$19.99 one-time replacing Notion and SaaS planner jobs with no per-seat fee.
